requirements.title: Launching the app shows an empty 3×3 board and the status "X's turn".
Tapping empty cells places X and O alternately, starting with X, and tapping an occupied cell changes nothing.
Each of the 8 winning lines (3 rows, 3 columns, 2 diagonals) ends the game with the status "X wins" or "O wins" for the right player, and no further moves are accepted.
A full board with no winning line shows the status "Draw".
The "New game" button clears the board and makes it X's turn again.
The rules live in the GameCore module, which imports no UI framework, and have unit tests that run without the UI.
The existing AppCoreTests, APIClient and LogClient tests keep passing.
